name: read-during-write-acceptance-seam-window
body: The read-during-write acceptance observes the reader at the injected BeforeCommit and BeforeProject seams, which run on the writer's thread while its blocking lock and read-write handle are held; it cannot pause inside the projection's single transaction, so a half-applied projection is excluded by the commit-then-project ordering rather than sampled mid-apply. Upgrade to a mid-projection fault-injection point if the projection transaction ever needs direct observation.
